text_note.zh: 本文用现行高中语文教材的文本。语料库的题目是《琵琶引》，这是白居易文集里的原题；课本题作《琵琶行并序》，前面还有一段序，这里没有收进诗句。和语料库文本相比，主要不同有：“秋瑟瑟”语料库作“秋索索”；“不得志”作“不得意”；“幽咽泉流冰下难”作“水下滩”，“冰泉冷涩弦凝绝，凝绝不通”作“水泉冷涩弦疑绝，疑绝不通”；“东船西舫”作“东舟西舫”；“名属教坊”作“名蜀”（是转换错误）；“善才服”作“善才伏”；“钿头银篦”作“钿头云篦”；“浔阳地僻无音乐”作“浔阳小处无音乐”。还有几处只是异体字，如“捻、瓶、沉、蟆、妒、裙、翻、猿”。其中“冰下难”和“水下滩”历来有争论，课本用“冰下难”。
text_note.en: This page uses the text in current high-school textbooks. The corpus title is Pipa Yin, the original title in Bai Juyi's collected works. Textbooks call it Pipa Xing with Preface; the prose preface is not included in the lines here. Compared with the corpus, the main differences are: sè sè (rustling) where the corpus has suǒ suǒ; bù dé zhì where the corpus has bù dé yì (both mean "not getting what one wished"); bīng xià nán ("struggling under ice") where the corpus has shuǐ xià tān ("down the rapids"); bīng quán and níng jué ("icy spring", "frozen") where the corpus has shuǐ quán and yí jué; dōng chuán where the corpus has dōng zhōu (both mean "east boat"); míng shǔ ("listed in") where the corpus has a conversion slip; shàn cái fú where the corpus has a variant character for fú; yín bì ("silver comb") where the corpus has yún bì ("cloud comb"); and dì pì ("remote") where the corpus has xiǎo chù ("small place"). Several others are only variant forms of the same character. Scholars have long argued over bīng xià nán versus shuǐ xià tān; textbooks use bīng xià nán.

readings.zh: “谁”口语多读 shéi，读诗时课本常标 shuí，两种都对。
readings.en: This character is often said shéi in speech; in poems textbooks usually mark shuí. Both are accepted.

readings.zh: “重开宴”的“重”是“再一次”，读 chóng。
readings.en: Here it means "again", so it is read chóng.

readings.zh: 转轴是旋转弦轴，按意思读 zhuàn；有的读本标 zhuǎn。
readings.en: Turning the pegs means rotating them, so it is read zhuàn; some books mark zhuǎn.

readings.zh: 这里指愁思，现在读 sī。旧时作名词读 sì，有的读本仍标 sì。
readings.en: Here it means sad thoughts and is read sī today. In old usage this noun was read sì, and some books still mark sì.

readings.zh: 弹琵琶的指法，一般读 mǒ；一说读 mò。
readings.en: A pipa playing move, usually read mǒ; some read it mò.

readings.zh: 往上拨弦，读 tiǎo，不读 tiāo。
readings.en: Flicking the string upward is read tiǎo, not tiāo.

readings.zh: “初为”是“先弹”，读 wéi。
readings.en: Here it means "to play, to do", read wéi.

readings.zh: “霓裳”读 ní cháng。
readings.en: In ní cháng (rainbow skirt), this character is read cháng.

readings.zh: “间关”读 jiān guān，形容鸟叫。
readings.en: In jiān guān, a word for birdsong, it is read jiān.

readings.zh: “幽咽”的“咽”指哭声堵在喉咙里，读 yè，不读 yān 或 yàn。
readings.en: Here it means a sob caught in the throat, read yè, not yān or yàn.

readings.zh: 现在规范读 qí。旧读 jì，指骑兵，一些老教材标 jì。
readings.en: The standard reading today is qí. The old reading jì, meaning horseman, appears in some older textbooks.

readings.zh: 现代口语“衣裳”读 yīshang；读古诗时一般读 yī cháng。
readings.en: In everyday speech yīshang; in old poems it is usually read yī cháng.

readings.zh: “虾蟆”就是“蛤蟆”，读 há má，不读 xiā。
readings.en: Há má here means a toad, read há, not xiā.

readings.zh: “教”是“使、让”的意思，读 jiào。
readings.en: Here it means "made, caused", read jiào.

readings.zh: “年少”指年轻人，读 shào。
readings.en: Nián shào means young people, read shào.

readings.zh: “血色”在书面语里读 xuè。
readings.en: In written words like this, it is read xuè.

readings.zh: “朝”是早晨，读 zhāo，不读 cháo。
readings.en: Here it means morning, read zhāo, not cháo.

readings.zh: “少年”读 shào。
readings.en: In shào nián (youth), it is read shào.

readings.zh: “重唧唧”是又一次叹息，读 chóng。
readings.en: Here it means "once more", read chóng.

readings.zh: “音乐”读 yuè。
readings.en: In yīn yuè (music), it is read yuè.

readings.zh: “花朝”是开花的早晨，读 zhāo。
readings.en: Huā zhāo means a flowery morning, read zhāo.

readings.zh: 这里是“仍然、又”的意思，一般读 hái；一说读 huán。
readings.en: Here it means "still, again", usually read hái; some read huán.

readings.zh: “嘲哳”形容声音杂乱，读 zhāo zhā，不读 cháo。
readings.en: In zhāo zhā, a word for jarring noise, it is read zhāo, not cháo.

readings.zh: “难为听”的“为”读 wéi。
readings.en: In nán wéi tīng it is read wéi.

readings.zh: “仙乐”是音乐，读 yuè。
readings.en: Xiān yuè is music, so it is read yuè.

readings.zh: “更坐”是再坐，读 gèng。
readings.en: Gèng zuò means sit again, read gèng.

readings.zh: “为君”是替你、给你，读 wèi。
readings.en: Wèi jūn means for you, read wèi.

readings.zh: 诗体名“行”读 xíng，不读 háng。
readings.en: As the name of a kind of poem, it is read xíng, not háng.

readings.zh: “重闻”是再一次听，读 chóng。
readings.en: Chóng wén means hear again, read chóng.

readings.zh: 读诗时常标 shuí，口语也可读 shéi。
readings.en: Usually marked shuí in poems; shéi is also accepted.

glosses.zh: 浔阳江头：浔阳江边。浔阳江是长江流过今天江西九江一带的那一段。
glosses.en: xún yáng jiāng tóu: the bank of the Xunyang River, the stretch of the Yangtze near today's Jiujiang in Jiangxi.

glosses.zh: 荻花：荻是长在水边的一种草，像芦苇，秋天开白色的花。
glosses.en: dí huā: the flowers of dí, a reed-like grass by the water that blooms white in autumn.

glosses.zh: 瑟瑟：风吹草木的声音，也有冷清、萧条的感觉。
glosses.en: sè sè: the rustle of wind in leaves and grass; it also feels cold and lonely.

glosses.zh: 主人：主人，指诗人自己。
glosses.en: zhǔ rén: the host, meaning the poet himself.

glosses.zh: 管弦：管乐器和弦乐器，这里泛指音乐。
glosses.en: guǎn xián: wind and string instruments; here, music in general.

glosses.zh: 惨将别：心里难过，就要分别了。
glosses.en: cǎn jiāng bié: sad, about to say goodbye.

glosses.zh: 茫茫：辽阔模糊、看不清边的样子。
glosses.en: máng máng: wide and dim, with no end in sight.

glosses.zh: 江浸月：月亮的倒影浸在江水里。
glosses.en: jiāng jìn yuè: the moon's reflection soaking in the river.

glosses.zh: 不发：不出发，不走了。
glosses.en: bù fā: does not set off.

glosses.zh: 暗问：小声地问。
glosses.en: àn wèn: asks quietly.

glosses.zh: 欲语迟：想回答，却迟迟没有开口。
glosses.en: yù yǔ chí: wants to answer but is slow to speak.

glosses.zh: 邀相见：邀请她出来见面。
glosses.en: yāo xiāng jiàn: invites her to come and meet them.

glosses.zh: 回灯：把灯重新点亮，或把灯移回来。
glosses.en: huí dēng: relights the lamps, or brings them back.

glosses.zh: 重开宴：重新摆开酒席。
glosses.en: chóng kāi yàn: sets out the feast again.

glosses.zh: 始：才。
glosses.en: shǐ: only then.

glosses.zh: 犹：还、仍然。
glosses.en: yóu: still.

glosses.zh: 转轴：拧动琴头上调弦的轴，把弦调准。
glosses.en: zhuàn zhóu: turning the pegs at the top of the pipa to tune the strings.

glosses.zh: 拨弦：用手指或拨子弹弦，这里是试音。
glosses.en: bō xián: plucking the strings; here, to test the sound.

glosses.zh: 曲调：完整的曲子。
glosses.en: qǔ diào: a whole tune.

glosses.zh: 掩抑：声音低沉、压抑，像在压住心里的话。
glosses.en: yǎn yì: low and held back, as if holding in what the heart wants to say.

glosses.zh: 思：悲伤的情思，愁思。
glosses.en: sī: sad thoughts, sorrow.

glosses.zh: 平生：一辈子。
glosses.en: píng shēng: one's whole life.

glosses.zh: 不得志：心愿没能实现，过得不如意。
glosses.en: bù dé zhì: never getting what one hoped for in life.

glosses.zh: 低眉：低着头，眼睛往下看。
glosses.en: dī méi: with lowered eyes and head bent.

glosses.zh: 信手：随手，很自然地弹。
glosses.en: xìn shǒu: letting the hands move freely.

glosses.zh: 续续：接连不断。
glosses.en: xù xù: on and on, without a break.

glosses.zh: 拢：左手手指按弦并来回揉动，是一种弹琵琶的指法。下面的“捻、抹、挑”也都是指法。
glosses.en: lǒng: pressing a string with the left hand and rubbing it, a way of playing the pipa. Niǎn, mǒ and tiǎo next are also ways of playing.

glosses.zh: 捻：左手手指在弦上揉动。
glosses.en: niǎn: rolling a finger of the left hand on a string.

glosses.zh: 抹：右手手指向左拨弦，顺手往下弹。
glosses.en: mǒ: a finger of the right hand sweeps the string inward and down.

glosses.zh: 挑：右手手指反过来往上拨弦。
glosses.en: tiǎo: a finger of the right hand flicks the string back outward.

glosses.zh: 复：又。
glosses.en: fù: and then again.

glosses.zh: 霓裳：《霓裳羽衣曲》，唐代有名的乐舞曲。
glosses.en: ní cháng: the Rainbow Skirt and Feather Dress, a famous Tang dance tune.

glosses.zh: 六幺：唐代流行的一种曲子，也叫《绿腰》。
glosses.en: liù yāo: a popular Tang tune, also called Green Waist.

glosses.zh: 大弦：琵琶上最粗的弦，声音低沉。
glosses.en: dà xián: the thickest string of the pipa, with a deep sound.

glosses.zh: 嘈嘈：声音又重又急。
glosses.en: cáo cáo: heavy and fast, like pounding rain.

glosses.zh: 小弦：琵琶上最细的弦，声音尖细。
glosses.en: xiǎo xián: the thinnest string, with a high, thin sound.

glosses.zh: 切切：声音又细又轻。
glosses.en: qiè qiè: soft and fine, like a whisper.

glosses.zh: 私语：悄悄话。
glosses.en: sī yǔ: secret whispers.

glosses.zh: 错杂：交错混合在一起。
glosses.en: cuò zá: mixed and woven together.

glosses.zh: 玉盘：玉做的盘子。珠子落在上面，声音清脆。
glosses.en: yù pán: a jade plate. Pearls falling on it make a clear, bright sound.

glosses.zh: 间关：鸟叫的声音，宛转好听。
glosses.en: jiān guān: the sound of a bird singing, smooth and lovely.

glosses.zh: 莺语：黄莺的叫声。
glosses.en: yīng yǔ: the song of the oriole.

glosses.zh: 花底滑：在花下流畅地滑过。
glosses.en: huā dǐ huá: slipping smoothly beneath the flowers.

glosses.zh: 幽咽：低低的、像哭泣一样断断续续的声音。
glosses.en: yōu yè: a low, broken sound, like quiet sobbing.

glosses.zh: 冰下难：泉水在冰下流动，流得很艰难。
glosses.en: bīng xià nán: water struggling to flow under ice.

glosses.zh: 冷涩：又冷又不顺畅。
glosses.en: lěng sè: cold and stiff, not flowing.

glosses.zh: 凝绝：凝住了，停住了。
glosses.en: níng jué: frozen, stopped.

glosses.zh: 暂歇：暂时停下。
glosses.en: zàn xiē: pauses for a moment.

glosses.zh: 幽愁暗恨：藏在心底的忧愁和怨恨。
glosses.en: yōu chóu àn hèn: sorrow and resentment hidden deep inside.

glosses.zh: 胜：超过，比……更好。
glosses.en: shèng: is better than.

glosses.zh: 乍破：突然破裂。
glosses.en: zhà pò: suddenly bursts.

glosses.zh: 水浆迸：水一下子溅出来。
glosses.en: shuǐ jiāng bèng: water splashes out all at once.

glosses.zh: 铁骑：披着铁甲的骑兵。
glosses.en: tiě qí: horsemen in iron armor.

glosses.zh: 突出：突然冲出来。
glosses.en: tū chū: charge out suddenly.

glosses.zh: 收拨：收起拨子。拨子是弹琵琶用的小片。
glosses.en: shōu bō: puts away the plectrum, the small piece used to strike the strings.

glosses.zh: 当心画：用拨子在琵琶中间用力划过四根弦，这是一曲结束时的弹法。
glosses.en: dāng xīn huà: sweeps the plectrum hard across all four strings at the middle of the pipa, the way a piece ends.

glosses.zh: 裂帛：撕开丝绸，声音清脆响亮。
glosses.en: liè bó: tearing silk, a sharp ringing sound.

glosses.zh: 舫：船。
glosses.en: fǎng: a boat.

glosses.zh: 悄无言：静悄悄的，没有人说话。
glosses.en: qiǎo wú yán: so quiet that nobody speaks.

glosses.zh: 沉吟：想说又有些犹豫的样子。
glosses.en: chén yín: hesitating, as if about to speak.

glosses.zh: 整顿：整理。
glosses.en: zhěng dùn: to straighten, to tidy.

glosses.zh: 敛容：收起刚才的表情，变得端庄严肃。
glosses.en: liǎn róng: composes her face and looks serious.

glosses.zh: 京城：首都，指唐朝的长安。
glosses.en: jīng chéng: the capital, Chang'an in the Tang dynasty.

glosses.zh: 虾蟆陵：长安城东南的一个地方，是歌女们住的地方。
glosses.en: há má líng: a place in the southeast of Chang'an where many singers lived.

glosses.zh: 名属：名字登记在。
glosses.en: míng shǔ: her name was listed in.

glosses.zh: 教坊：唐朝管理宫廷音乐、教歌舞的机构。
glosses.en: jiào fāng: the Tang office that trained musicians and dancers for the court.

glosses.zh: 第一部：第一队，最好的一组。
glosses.en: dì yī bù: the first troupe, the best group.

glosses.zh: 曲罢：一曲弹完。
glosses.en: qǔ bà: when a piece was finished.

glosses.zh: 教：使、让。
glosses.en: jiào: made, caused.

glosses.zh: 善才：唐代对琵琶高手、音乐老师的称呼。
glosses.en: shàn cái: the Tang name for master musicians and music teachers.

glosses.zh: 服：佩服。
glosses.en: fú: to admire, to be won over.

glosses.zh: 秋娘：唐代对美丽歌女的通称。
glosses.en: qiū niáng: a common Tang name for beautiful singing girls.

glosses.zh: 五陵年少：京城富贵人家的子弟。五陵是长安附近汉代五个皇帝的陵墓，那里住着很多有钱人。
glosses.en: wǔ líng nián shào: rich young men of the capital. The Five Tombs near Chang'an were burial grounds of five Han emperors, where many wealthy families lived.

glosses.zh: 缠头：送给歌女舞女的礼物，多是丝绸。
glosses.en: chán tóu: gifts given to singers and dancers, usually silk.

glosses.zh: 红绡：红色的薄丝绸。
glosses.en: hóng xiāo: thin red silk.

glosses.zh: 钿头银篦：头上镶着花饰的银梳子。篦是齿很密的梳子。
glosses.en: diàn tóu yín bì: a silver comb with a jeweled top. A bì is a fine-toothed comb.

glosses.zh: 击节：打拍子。
glosses.en: jī jié: to beat time.

glosses.zh: 罗裙：丝织的裙子。
glosses.en: luó qún: a silk skirt.

glosses.zh: 翻酒污：酒洒翻了，把裙子弄脏。
glosses.en: fān jiǔ wū: stained by spilled wine.

glosses.zh: 复：又。
glosses.en: fù: again, and then.

glosses.zh: 等闲度：随随便便地过去了，不当回事。
glosses.en: děng xián dù: passed by carelessly, without a thought.

glosses.zh: 阿姨：这里指教坊里管她的养母或姐妹。一说是姨母。
glosses.en: ā yí: here, the older woman in charge of her at the music office, like a foster mother. Some say it means her aunt.

glosses.zh: 颜色故：容貌变老了。颜色，脸色、容貌。
glosses.en: yán sè gù: her looks grew old. Yán sè here means face, looks.

glosses.zh: 冷落：冷清，没人来。
glosses.en: lěng luò: deserted, with no visitors.

glosses.zh: 鞍马稀：来的车马很少。指客人少了。
glosses.en: ān mǎ xī: few horses at the gate, meaning few guests came.

glosses.zh: 老大：年纪大了。
glosses.en: lǎo dà: grown old.

glosses.zh: 重利：看重钱财。
glosses.en: zhòng lì: values money highly.

glosses.zh: 轻别离：不把分别当回事。
glosses.en: qīng bié lí: thinks little of being apart.

glosses.zh: 浮梁：地名，在今天的江西景德镇一带，唐代那里出产茶叶。
glosses.en: fú liáng: a place near today's Jingdezhen in Jiangxi, known for tea in the Tang dynasty.

glosses.zh: 去来：走了以后。
glosses.en: qù lái: since he left.

glosses.zh: 妆泪：带着脂粉的眼泪。
glosses.en: zhuāng lèi: tears mixed with makeup.

glosses.zh: 红阑干：脸上流满了被胭脂染红的泪水。阑干，纵横交错的样子。
glosses.en: hóng lán gān: red streaks of tears running every way across her face.

glosses.zh: 叹息：叹气。
glosses.en: tàn xī: to sigh.

glosses.zh: 重唧唧：又一次叹息。唧唧，叹息声。
glosses.en: chóng jī jī: sighs again. Jī jī is the sound of sighing.

glosses.zh: 天涯：天边，极远的地方。
glosses.en: tiān yá: the far ends of the earth.

glosses.zh: 沦落：流落，失意落魄。
glosses.en: lún luò: fallen on hard times, far from home.

glosses.zh: 何必：为什么一定要。
glosses.en: hé bì: why must, there is no need.

glosses.zh: 曾相识：以前就认识。
glosses.en: céng xiāng shí: to have known each other before.

glosses.zh: 辞帝京：离开京城长安。
glosses.en: cí dì jīng: left the capital, Chang'an.

glosses.zh: 谪居：被降职贬到外地居住。
glosses.en: zhé jū: living far away after being demoted.

glosses.zh: 地僻：地方偏僻。
glosses.en: dì pì: a remote place.

glosses.zh: 终岁：一整年。
glosses.en: zhōng suì: the whole year.

glosses.zh: 丝竹：弦乐器和管乐器，代指音乐。
glosses.en: sī zhú: silk and bamboo, meaning string and wind instruments, or music.

glosses.zh: 湓江：湓水，在九江流入长江。
glosses.en: pén jiāng: the Pen River, which joins the Yangtze at Jiujiang.

glosses.zh: 低湿：地势低，很潮湿。
glosses.en: dī shī: low-lying and damp.

glosses.zh: 黄芦苦竹：枯黄的芦苇和苦竹。苦竹是一种竹子，笋有苦味。
glosses.en: huáng lú kǔ zhú: yellow reeds and bitter bamboo, a kind of bamboo whose shoots taste bitter.

glosses.zh: 绕宅：围着住宅。
glosses.en: rào zhái: around the house.

glosses.zh: 旦暮：早晨和晚上。
glosses.en: dàn mù: morning and evening.

glosses.zh: 杜鹃啼血：杜鹃鸟叫声很悲，传说它叫到嘴里流血。
glosses.en: dù juān tí xuè: the cuckoo's cry is so sad that legend says it cries until it bleeds.

glosses.zh: 猿哀鸣：猿猴悲哀地叫。
glosses.en: yuán āi míng: apes crying sadly.

glosses.zh: 花朝：开满花的早晨。
glosses.en: huā zhāo: a morning full of flowers.

glosses.zh: 独倾：一个人喝酒。倾，倒酒、喝干。
glosses.en: dú qīng: drinking alone. Qīng means to pour, to empty the cup.

glosses.zh: 岂无：难道没有。
glosses.en: qǐ wú: is it that there are none?

glosses.zh: 呕哑嘲哳：形容声音杂乱刺耳。
glosses.en: ōu yā zhāo zhā: harsh, jumbled, grating sounds.

glosses.zh: 难为听：很难听下去。
glosses.en: nán wéi tīng: hard to listen to.

glosses.zh: 琵琶语：琵琶弹出的声音，像在说话。
glosses.en: pí pá yǔ: the pipa's music, as if it were speaking.

glosses.zh: 仙乐：仙界的音乐。
glosses.en: xiān yuè: music of the immortals.

glosses.zh: 耳暂明：耳朵一下子清亮起来。
glosses.en: ěr zàn míng: my ears suddenly feel clear and bright.

glosses.zh: 莫辞：不要推辞。
glosses.en: mò cí: please don't refuse.

glosses.zh: 更坐：再坐下来。
glosses.en: gèng zuò: sit down again.

glosses.zh: 翻作：按曲子写成歌词，这里指写诗。
glosses.en: fān zuò: to set words to the music; here, to write a poem.

glosses.zh: 琵琶行：行，古诗的一种体裁，多是长诗，可以歌唱。
glosses.en: pí pá xíng: The Pipa Song. Xíng is a kind of old poem, usually long, that could be sung.

glosses.zh: 良久：很久。
glosses.en: liáng jiǔ: for a long time.

glosses.zh: 却坐：退回去坐下。
glosses.en: què zuò: steps back and sits down.

glosses.zh: 促弦：把弦拧紧。弦紧了，声音更高更急。
glosses.en: cù xián: tightens the strings, which makes the sound higher and faster.

glosses.zh: 转急：变得更急。
glosses.en: zhuǎn jí: grows faster.

glosses.zh: 凄凄：凄凉悲伤。
glosses.en: qī qī: sad and chilling.

glosses.zh: 向前声：刚才的声音。
glosses.en: xiàng qián shēng: the sound from before.

glosses.zh: 掩泣：捂着脸哭。
glosses.en: yǎn qì: cover their faces and cry.

glosses.zh: 江州司马：诗人自己。白居易当时被贬为江州司马，是个闲官。
glosses.en: jiāng zhōu sī mǎ: the poet himself. Bai Juyi had been demoted to Sima of Jiangzhou, a post with little real work.

glosses.zh: 青衫：青色的官服。唐代官位低的人穿青色。
glosses.en: qīng shān: a dark blue-green robe, worn by low-ranking officials in the Tang dynasty.

translation.zh: 夜里，我在浔阳江边送别客人，
translation.en: At night I saw a guest off on the bank of the Xunyang River.

translation.zh: 枫叶和荻花在秋风里瑟瑟作响。
translation.en: Maple leaves and reed flowers rustled in the autumn wind.

translation.zh: 我下了马，客人已经上了船，
translation.en: I got off my horse; my guest was already on the boat.

translation.zh: 举起酒杯要喝，却没有音乐助兴。
translation.en: We raised our cups to drink, but there was no music.

translation.zh: 喝醉了也不快乐，只能伤心地分别，
translation.en: Drinking brought no joy, only the sadness of parting.

translation.zh: 分别时，茫茫江水里浸着一轮月亮。
translation.en: As we parted, the moon lay soaking in the wide, dim river.

translation.zh: 忽然听见水面上传来琵琶声，
translation.en: Suddenly we heard a pipa playing on the water.

translation.zh: 我忘了回去，客人也不出发了。
translation.en: I forgot to go home, and my guest did not set off.

translation.zh: 循着声音小声问：弹琵琶的是谁？
translation.en: Following the sound, we asked softly who was playing.

translation.zh: 琵琶声停了，她想回答，却迟迟没开口。
translation.en: The music stopped. She wanted to answer but was slow to speak.

translation.zh: 我们把船移近，请她出来相见，
translation.en: We moved our boat closer and asked her to meet us.

translation.zh: 添了酒，重新点亮灯，又摆开了酒席。
translation.en: We poured more wine, lit the lamps again and began the feast anew.

translation.zh: 叫了千百遍，她才肯出来，
translation.en: Only after we called a thousand times did she come out,

translation.zh: 还抱着琵琶，遮住半边脸。
translation.en: still holding the pipa so it hid half her face.

translation.zh: 她拧动弦轴，拨了两三声试音，
translation.en: She turned the pegs and plucked two or three notes to test them.

translation.zh: 还没成曲子，就已经满含感情。
translation.en: Before any tune began, the notes were already full of feeling.

translation.zh: 每根弦都低沉压抑，每个声音都含着愁思，
translation.en: Every string sounded low and held back; every note was full of sorrow,

translation.zh: 好像在诉说她一辈子的不如意。
translation.en: as if telling of a whole life that went wrong.

translation.zh: 她低着头，随手连续不断地弹，
translation.en: Head bent, she played on and on, letting her hands move freely,

translation.zh: 把心里无数的心事都说了出来。
translation.en: telling all the countless things in her heart.

translation.zh: 轻轻地拢，慢慢地捻，又抹又挑，
translation.en: She pressed lightly, rolled slowly, swept down and flicked up.

translation.zh: 先弹《霓裳》，后弹《六幺》。
translation.en: First she played Rainbow Skirt, then Green Waist.

translation.zh: 粗弦声音沉重急促，像一阵急雨，
translation.en: The thick string pounded like a sudden downpour;

translation.zh: 细弦声音轻细，像有人说悄悄话。
translation.en: the thin string whispered like secret talk.

translation.zh: 重的轻的声音交错着弹出来，
translation.en: Heavy and soft notes poured out, woven together,

translation.zh: 像大大小小的珍珠落在玉盘上。
translation.en: like big and small pearls falling on a jade plate.

translation.zh: 一会儿像黄莺在花下宛转地唱，
translation.en: Now it was like an oriole singing smoothly beneath the flowers;

translation.zh: 一会儿像泉水在冰下艰难地呜咽流淌。
translation.en: now like a spring sobbing as it struggles under ice.

translation.zh: 泉水像是冻住了，弦声也像凝住了，
translation.en: The icy spring seemed to freeze, and the strings seemed to stop.

translation.zh: 凝住不通，声音暂时停了下来。
translation.en: Frozen and blocked, the sound paused for a while.

translation.zh: 另有一种深藏的忧愁和怨恨生出来，
translation.en: Then a hidden sorrow and grief rose up;

translation.zh: 这时没有声音，反而比有声音更动人。
translation.en: at that moment, silence said more than sound.

translation.zh: 忽然像银瓶破裂，水一下子迸溅出来，
translation.en: Suddenly it was like a silver jar bursting and water splashing out,

translation.zh: 又像铁甲骑兵冲出，刀枪铿锵作响。
translation.en: like armored horsemen charging out, swords and spears clashing.

translation.zh: 一曲终了，她收起拨子在琴中间一划，
translation.en: As the piece ended, she drew the plectrum hard across the middle,

translation.zh: 四根弦同时发声，像撕裂丝绸一样。
translation.en: and all four strings rang out at once, like silk being torn.

translation.zh: 东边西边的船上都静悄悄的，没人说话，
translation.en: On the boats east and west, all was silent; no one spoke.

translation.zh: 只看见江心映着一轮白白的秋月。
translation.en: We saw only the white autumn moon in the middle of the river.

translation.zh: 她犹豫着把拨子插在弦中间，
translation.en: Hesitating, she tucked the plectrum between the strings,

translation.zh: 整理好衣裳，站起来，脸色变得庄重。
translation.en: straightened her clothes, stood up and composed her face.

translation.zh: 她说自己本来是京城长安的女子，
translation.en: She said she had once been a girl of the capital, Chang'an,

translation.zh: 家住在虾蟆陵一带。
translation.en: living near Hama Ling.

translation.zh: 十三岁就学会了弹琵琶，
translation.en: At thirteen she had mastered the pipa,

translation.zh: 名字列在教坊第一队里。
translation.en: and her name was on the list of the best troupe of the court music office.

translation.zh: 每弹完一曲，连琵琶高手都佩服她，
translation.en: Every time she finished a piece, even the master musicians admired her;

translation.zh: 每次打扮好，都让美丽的歌女们嫉妒。
translation.en: every time she dressed up, the other beauties were jealous.

translation.zh: 京城的富家子弟争着送她礼物，
translation.en: Rich young men of the capital fought to give her gifts;

translation.zh: 弹一曲，得到的红绸多得数不清。
translation.en: for one tune she got more red silk than she could count.

translation.zh: 镶着花饰的银梳，因为打拍子而敲碎了，
translation.en: Silver combs with jeweled tops broke as she beat time with them;

translation.zh: 血红的丝裙，被翻倒的酒弄脏了。
translation.en: blood-red silk skirts were stained with spilled wine.

translation.zh: 今年欢笑，明年还是欢笑，
translation.en: She laughed this year, and laughed again the next,

translation.zh: 秋月春风，好时光随随便便就过去了。
translation.en: letting autumn moons and spring breezes slip by without a thought.

translation.zh: 后来弟弟去参军，管她的阿姨也死了，
translation.en: Then her brother went off to the army, and the woman who looked after her died.

translation.zh: 日子一天天过去，她的容貌也老了。
translation.en: Evenings went and mornings came, and her looks faded.

translation.zh: 门前冷冷清清，来的客人越来越少，
translation.en: Her gate grew lonely; few horses stopped there now.

translation.zh: 年纪大了，只好嫁给一个商人做妻子。
translation.en: Grown old, she married a merchant.

translation.zh: 商人看重钱，不把分别当回事，
translation.en: A merchant cares for money and thinks little of being apart;

translation.zh: 上个月就到浮梁买茶去了。
translation.en: last month he went off to Fuliang to buy tea.

translation.zh: 他走后，我在江口守着空船，
translation.en: Since he left, she has kept the empty boat at the river mouth,

translation.zh: 围着船的是明亮的月光和寒冷的江水。
translation.en: with bright moonlight all around and the cold river water.

translation.zh: 夜深了，忽然梦见年轻时的事，
translation.en: Deep in the night she suddenly dreamed of her young days,

translation.zh: 在梦里哭醒，泪水和着胭脂流了满脸。
translation.en: and cried in her dream until tears red with makeup streaked her face.

translation.zh: 我听了琵琶声，已经在叹息，
translation.en: Hearing the pipa, I had already sighed;

translation.zh: 又听了她这番话，更加叹息不止。
translation.en: hearing her story, I sighed again and again.

translation.zh: 我们都是流落天涯、失意的人，
translation.en: We are both people fallen on hard times, far from home.

translation.zh: 今天相遇了，何必一定要从前就认识！
translation.en: Now that we have met, why should it matter that we never knew each other before?

translation.zh: 我从去年离开京城长安，
translation.en: Last year I left the capital,

translation.zh: 被贬到浔阳城，常常生病躺着。
translation.en: and was sent down to Xunyang, where I often lie ill.

translation.zh: 浔阳地方偏僻，没有什么音乐，
translation.en: Xunyang is remote and has no music;

translation.zh: 一整年都听不到弦乐和管乐的声音。
translation.en: all year I never hear strings or flutes.

translation.zh: 我住在湓江边，地势低又潮湿，
translation.en: I live by the Pen River, on low, damp ground,

translation.zh: 枯黄的芦苇和苦竹围着房子生长。
translation.en: with yellow reeds and bitter bamboo growing round my house.

translation.zh: 在这里，早晚能听到什么呢？
translation.en: What do I hear here, morning and evening?

translation.zh: 只有杜鹃悲啼和猿猴哀叫。
translation.en: Only the cuckoo crying blood and the apes wailing.

translation.zh: 春天江边开花的早晨，秋天有月亮的夜晚，
translation.en: On spring mornings of flowers by the river, and autumn nights of moonlight,

translation.zh: 我常常拿来酒，一个人独自喝。
translation.en: I often take some wine and drink it alone.

translation.zh: 难道没有山歌和村里的笛声吗？
translation.en: Are there no mountain songs or village flutes?

translation.zh: 有，可是声音杂乱刺耳，实在难听。
translation.en: There are, but they are harsh and jarring, hard to listen to.

translation.zh: 今晚听了你弹的琵琶，
translation.en: Tonight, hearing your pipa speak,

translation.zh: 好像听到了仙乐，耳朵一下子清亮了。
translation.en: it is like hearing music of the immortals; my ears feel clear at once.

translation.zh: 请不要推辞，再坐下来弹一曲吧，
translation.en: Please don't refuse. Sit down and play one more piece,

translation.zh: 我要为你写一首《琵琶行》。
translation.en: and I will write a Pipa Song for you.

translation.zh: 她被我的话感动了，站了很久，
translation.en: Moved by my words, she stood for a long time,

translation.zh: 然后退回去坐下，拧紧琴弦，弦声变得更急。
translation.en: then sat back down and tightened the strings, and the music grew faster.

translation.zh: 声音凄凉，不像刚才那样，
translation.en: It was sadder now, not like the music before,

translation.zh: 满座的人再听，都捂着脸哭了。
translation.en: and everyone listening again covered their faces and wept.

translation.zh: 在座的人中，谁的眼泪流得最多？
translation.en: Of all who sat there, whose tears flowed most?

translation.zh: 是我这个江州司马，青色的衣衫都湿透了。
translation.en: It was I, the Sima of Jiangzhou; my blue-green robe was soaked through.

background.zh: 元和十年（815年），宰相武元衡在长安街头被刺杀。白居易第一个上书，要求赶快捉拿凶手，却被说成是越职言事（管了不该自己管的事），又遭人诬陷，被贬为江州司马。江州就是今天的江西九江。第二年秋天，他在湓浦口送客，夜里听到船上有人弹琵琶，有京城的味道。一问，弹琴的是从前长安的歌女，年老后嫁给了商人。白居易想到自己的遭遇，写下了这首长诗。这些经过都写在诗前的序里。
background.en: In 815 the chief minister Wu Yuanheng was murdered in the streets of Chang'an. Bai Juyi was the first to write to the emperor, asking that the killers be caught at once. He was accused of meddling in matters that were not his job, was slandered as well, and was sent away as Sima of Jiangzhou. Jiangzhou is today's Jiujiang in Jiangxi. The next autumn, seeing off a guest at Penpu, he heard someone playing the pipa on a boat at night, in the style of the capital. The player turned out to be a former singer of Chang'an who had married a merchant when she grew old. Thinking of his own fate, Bai wrote this long poem. The poet tells all this in the preface before the poem.

author_note.zh: 白居易（772—846），字乐天，号香山居士，唐代大诗人。他主张诗要写真实的社会和人生，语言要平易，让普通人也听得懂。《琵琶行》和《长恨歌》是他最有名的两首长诗。写这首诗时，他四十多岁，刚从京城被贬到偏远的江州，心里满是委屈和失落，所以特别能体会琵琶女的心情。
author_note.en: Bai Juyi (772–846), also called Letian and the Hermit of Xiangshan, was a great Tang poet. He believed poems should show real society and real lives, in plain words that ordinary people could understand. Song of the Pipa and Song of Everlasting Sorrow are his two most famous long poems. When he wrote this one he was in his forties and had just been sent from the capital to remote Jiangzhou. He felt wronged and lost, so he understood the pipa player's feelings deeply.

appreciation.zh: 这首诗像一部短电影，分成几场。第一场：秋夜江边送客，没有音乐，只有冷冷的月亮浸在江水里。第二场：琵琶声响起，女子千呼万唤才出来，还抱着琵琶遮住半边脸。第三场是全诗最精彩的音乐描写：急雨、私语、珠子落在玉盘上、黄莺唱歌、泉水在冰下呜咽，声音停下时“此时无声胜有声”，接着又像银瓶破裂、铁骑冲出。看不见的声音，被写得能看见、能摸到。最后一声像撕开丝绸，四周一片安静，只有江心一轮秋月。第四场：女子讲自己的一生，从红极一时到年老孤单。第五场：诗人说起自己被贬的苦，说出了“同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识”。一个歌女，一个官员，身份不同，失意的心却一样。最后琵琶再响，满座落泪，哭得最厉害的就是诗人自己。
appreciation.en: This poem is like a short film in several scenes. Scene one: seeing off a guest by the river on an autumn night. There is no music, only a cold moon soaking in the water. Scene two: the pipa begins. The woman comes out only after a thousand calls, still hiding half her face behind the pipa. Scene three is the best music writing in the whole poem: pounding rain, whispers, pearls falling on a jade plate, an oriole singing, a spring sobbing under ice. When the music stops, "silence says more than sound". Then it bursts out like a silver jar breaking and armored horsemen charging. Sound you cannot see becomes something you can see and almost touch. The last note is like tearing silk; then all is quiet, with only the autumn moon in the river. Scene four: the woman tells her life, from her days of fame to a lonely old age. Scene five: the poet tells of his own exile and says, "We are both people fallen on hard times, far from home; now that we meet, why must we have known each other before?" A singer and an official are very different, but their broken hopes are the same. At last the pipa plays again, everyone weeps, and the one who cries most is the poet himself.
